name: factory-feature-builder
description: Feature factory pipeline: spec-writer (Opus) -> builder (Opus) -> parallel review by security (Opus), UX, UI design and code (Sonnet) -> loop back to builder until clean -> approver (Opus) pushes a new branch and opens a PR, or escalates to need-human.

github_repo_url.title: GitHub repository URL
github_repo_url.description: Repo the approver pushes the factory branch to and opens the PR against (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo). Leave empty to never push: approved work is only committed locally.

max_iterations.title: Max build/review iterations
max_iterations.description: How many builder -> reviewers rounds before the approver decides (escalating if changes are still requested).
